title: Line-level EQ on vocals and no mixing in mono
summary: He bought a separate mic preamp for the vocalist to use the line-level EQ; with direct-to-mono recording there was no mixing afterwards.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: But still, I mean, you said something about mixing. You didn't... You really couldn't... No. You were going directly to mono and you were... Right.
There was no... There was no...
You either did it then or you didn't do it.
